question: What world comes after the eight bodies and which bodily disciplines begin there?
premises: Beyond the eight bodies is the world of the ten bodily properties.
These properties include non-harm, truth, and non-stealing.
They also include continence, freedom from deceit, freedom from anger, and a discipline related to the teacher.
inference: After the eight bodies comes a realm defined by ten ethical and bodily disciplines.
uncertainties: The final element guroḥ is compressed; it likely refers to service or reverence to the teacher as part of the ten.
plain_english: Beyond the eight bodies is the world of the ten bodily disciplines: non-harm, truthfulness, non-stealing, continence, freedom from deceit, freedom from anger, and discipline in relation to the teacher.
